text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the rumored clash of the Big 
Three, the Arima Kinen, Katsuragi Ace 
declares in her pre-race interview that 
she won't concede victory to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Symboli Rudolf declares she 
cannot lose to Mr. C.B. Unless she defeats 
the one reigning at the pinnacle, she 
cannot claim the throne of "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. was delighted by their joint 
interview, viewing it as the ultimate 
challenge letter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then she tells her Trainer: she's able 
to keep running freely like this only 
because of who her Trainer is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—The curtain rises on the Arima Kinen. 
Today, too, Mr. C.B. runs freely.
